sources.title: Pancreatic hormones, ADH synthesis/release and kidney water response

models.L061: Invented arbitrary-unit trace: reference50, illustrative band45–55, one disturbance then bounded correction. Snapshots not real time. Feedback-off removes only selected controller. No clinical values, individual assessment or all-controller prediction.
models.L062: Given internal warm/cold deviation. Assume air cooler than skin, fixed wind/clothing; humidity only changes qualitative evaporation conditions. Skin vessels redistribute heat; shivering generates heat. Arrow lengths not rates; no temperature or exposure recommendations.
models.L063: Relative high/low only. Beta→insulin and alpha→glucagon signals separated from glucose/glycogen matter. Usable liver stores assumed; glycogen is highlighted, not sole glucose source. No personal concentrations, diet, medication or disease assessment.
models.L064: Solute load and other conditions fixed; qualitative ADH–collecting-duct branch. ADH made in hypothalamus, released from posterior pituitary. Both states retain reabsorption; water moves down a suitable osmotic gradient. Relative urine output/concentration, not measured volume. Thirst distinguished from kidney conservation; no water creation or drinking advice.

status: pilot; independent science review and child trial pending
assets: Original text, questions and SVG authored for Study. No external figures, prose or data copied.
